# Ambrook

> Ambrook is accounting software purpose-built for America's family-run businesses, with integrated banking, inventory management, and tax preparation tools.

Ambrook specializes in financial management for agricultural, construction, and service-based businesses, offering industry-specific solutions including Schedule F tax prep, profitability tracking by enterprise, and integrated banking through Ambrook Wallet. The platform serves farms, ranches, equestrian operations, contractors, property managers, and other small business sectors.

## Key Topics

- Ambrook Wallet
- Schedule F tax preparation
- Profitability tracking
- Farm accounting
- Inventory management
- Invoicing & payment processing
- Financial reporting
- Bookkeeping
- Cost tracking
- Mobile app
- Full Service support
- QuickBooks alternative
- FDIC banking
- ACH payments
- Small business accounting

- [Ambrook - Accounting software made for America's family-run businesses](https://ambrook.com): Ambrook homepage: accounting software for family-run farming and ranching businesses

- [Ambrook Wallet - Banking and bookkeeping, finally together](https://ambrook.com/features/wallet): Ambrook Wallet: integrated business banking with 1% APY, invoicing, and check deposit
- [Ambrook Inventory - Inventory that syncs to your books](https://ambrook.com/features/inventory): Ambrook Inventory: livestock and farm inventory management synced to accounting books

## Industry Solutions

- [Ambrook for Farming - Production insights and tax prep in one place](https://ambrook.com/overview/farming): Ambrook for farms: enterprise tracking, Schedule F tax prep, and profitability insights
- [Ambrook for Ranchers - Know exactly what's making you money](https://ambrook.com/overview/ranchers): Ambrook for ranchers: diversified enterprise tracking and livestock profitability analysis
- [Ambrook for Equestrian Operations  - Track every horse and every dollar](https://ambrook.com/overview/equestrian): Ambrook for equestrian operations: boarding, training, and breeding profitability tracking
- [Ambrook for General Contractors - See which jobs make you money](https://ambrook.com/overview/contractors): Ambrook for contractors: job profitability tracking, invoicing, and mobile receipt capture
- [Ambrook for Construction - Know your exact margins](https://ambrook.com/overview/construction): Ambrook for construction: project profitability, invoice and payment management
- [Ambrook for Trucking - Stop hauling loads that lose money](https://ambrook.com/overview/trucking): Ambrook for trucking: owner-operator profitability by route and expense management
- [Ambrook for Property Managers - Know your true profitability per property](https://ambrook.com/overview/real-estate): Ambrook for property managers: per-property profitability and tax prep automation
- [Ambrook for Processors - Finances for those who love a good process](https://ambrook.com/overview/processing): Ambrook for processors: enterprise profitability and invoice management for ag processing
- [Ambrook for Manufacturing - Accounting software made for makers](https://ambrook.com/overview/manufacturing): Ambrook for manufacturing: COGS tracking, inventory, and profitability analysis
